runtime_network: none: served locally, no CDN or runtime install
selection_note: Chosen in the 2026-10-08 PlayIDE OSS survey: draw.io's engine, Apache-2.0, plain TypeScript with no framework. Pre-1.0, so the version is pinned. The bundle contains one `eval` helper (expression codec); PlayIDE never calls it and the page CSP has no 'unsafe-eval'.
source: npm install @maxgraph/core@0.25.0 --ignore-scripts; bundled unmodified with esbuild 0.25.10: `esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=maxgraph --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none` where entry.js is `export * from "@maxgraph/core";`
verified: 2026-10-08: rendered under the Studio's strict page CSP (no unsafe-inline, no unsafe-eval) in Chromium 141 with no CSP violations from the library.
